title: Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs
main_claim: Deciding joint-update k-WL equivalence (k in binary, explicit adjacency matrices) is EXPTIME-complete, even for connected simple uncolored graphs of equal order and max degree ≤ 3 (Theorem 1.1); also with unary k.
coverage: Read the full LaTeX (sections 1–8). Checked: (1) the dimension cap and the membership algorithm (2^{O(n log n)} rounds/labels); (2) the WL ⇔ (k+1)-slot game lemma in both directions, including the bijection being announced before Spoiler's choice and the bijectivity of the F map under history-dependent strategies; (3) the ring-tape simulation, where H_*=4T makes the halo [-T-2,T+2] injective mod H_*; the U/V/S AND-gate layering and rank acyclicity; the carry/borrow domains I_h^± and the wraparound singletons; the blank-suffix decomposition of j ≥ m'; seeds at t=0 and tests at t=H_*-1 being disjoint and terminal; (4) the scalar-image buffer: a true source forces {(0,0)} and so image {0}; the witness sets B_D work when all tests are false; the type and schema counts; (5) section 4: the square-equation cancellation under corner potentials; the support-tree lemma (a cycle or a path between two real types needs 4K+1 > K links); the wrapping lemma (the parity identity c_{i-1}+c_i=0 forces one block per row, and aligned-label parity recovers the address; two r-subsets agree via the common row at each boundary since r≥3); the shift lift in all three cases, including the endpoint map π=σ_e on A_e and the use of individual image equalities for surjectivity; the gauge lemma (s_v+s_w=ω, so the horizontal change is (δ_i+δ_i)g=0 and the vertical change is 0 by the shift difference); both inclusions of exact projection (at most one wrapping old component); (6) the Duplicator strategy (|U|≤r, so U∪{B}≤K; per-block preselected extensions); the ring transfer (squares B_{i-1},B_i share y_i; summing cancels the verticals and Σδ_i=1 gives L_t h_t+L_u h_u=b_ℓ; the old-side horizontals are copied while 1 spare slot is used); the wire transfer, the reverse direction and loop schemas; (7) the general realization (disjoint degree intervals j(N+1)..j(N+1)+N-1); (8) the subcubic realization: degree ≤3; port permutations in the local lifts that need no neighbor offset; the triangle-only-in-gadgets claim; sort recovery via path-length/degree tests; underlying adjacency with ≤6 slots; the readout walk with 4 slots, with nested tests valid as reached-history invariants; (9) the size and time accounting and the polarity of the final chain. I did not recompute the exact polynomial exponents in the time bounds (80 and 160) in detail, but they are generous upper bounds.
sibling_notes: Same family 133 as rank259 (Unconditional time lower bounds) and rank401 (Parity lifts), both of which were reported no_gap_found. This paper reproves the shared product-address, buffer and corner-potential machinery locally, uniformly in r, and does not depend circularly on the companions.
